subject: ParcelGrid customer narrative — draft for factual review and quote approval
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Park <janelle@parcelgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ParcelGrid customer narrative — draft for factual review and quote approval

Hi Janelle,

Thanks again for agreeing to do a short customer piece with us. Attached is a first-pass draft (parcelgrid_case_draft_v1.docx) that pulls together the background, architecture callouts, and the quote we captured in the demo. Can you please review for the following: 

1) Factual checks: product names, timelines, and the routing numbers (we want to avoid any overstated metrics).
2) Quote approval: we flagged a couple of sentences we pulled into the narrative — confirm the exact wording you want published.
3) Logo and case study consent: if Legal needs anything, please loop them in; we can wait on final sign-off for publish.

Target timeline: it would be great to have any edits back by EOD Friday so we can get the revised draft into the Feb partner newsletter. If that timeline is tight, let me know and we’ll adjust.

Attach: parcelgrid_case_draft_v1.docx

Appreciate it — excited to tell this story.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior SDR, Customer References
Redwood Inference
From: Janelle Park <janelle@parcelgrid.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Ramos <ben.ramos@redwood.com>, ParcelGrid Legal <legal@parcelgrid.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ParcelGrid customer narrative — draft for factual review and quote approval

Vivek —

Thanks for sending this over. We ran the draft by the engineering team and Legal; attached are our annotated redlines (parcelgrid_redlines_v1.pdf). High-level items: 

- "Routing engine" is correct; we did not use Redwood for caching — please remove the caching callouts in the architecture section.
- Metric tweak: our internal measurement showed a 37% reduction in average latency (not 40%). Please update the number and avoid the round-up.
- Quote: we’re fine with the sentiment but would prefer the wording be: "Redwood helped ParcelGrid reduce latency and cut request costs, enabling faster customer confirmations." 
- Legal: logo usage is OK, but they asked for a one-page release to be filled and signed before publication. I’ve CC’d Legal here.

We can get edits back to you by Monday afternoon. Attaching the PDF with inline comments.

Best,
Janelle
Head of Product
ParcelGrid

Attach: parcelgrid_redlines_v1.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: ParcelGrid redlines — can we get v2 ready?

Team — forwarding ParcelGrid’s redlines. Action items below (short):

- Marissa: can you incorporate the redlines into the doc and remove the caching section; update the latency metric to 37%. Also update the quote to the Janelle wording (exactly).
- Monica: coordinate the one-page release with ParcelGrid Legal; we’ll need a signed PDF before publishing.
- Laura: once Marissa’s updated doc is ready, please check the HubSpot reference record and add the final approved quote to the testimonial field.

Timeline: aim to send v2 back to ParcelGrid Monday morning so they can review and Legal can sign mid-week.

Thanks — Vivek
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ParcelGrid redlines — draft v2 attached

Team — attached is v2 (parcelgrid_case_draft_v2.docx). Changes made: removed caching language, updated latency metric to 37%, and swapped the quote to Janelle’s preferred wording. I also tightened the intro and added a short "what changed" bullet for readability.

Suggested final quote (inline options):
- Option A (short, publishable): "Redwood helped ParcelGrid reduce latency and cut request costs, enabling faster customer confirmations."
- Option B (attribution with a number): "Working with Redwood reduced our average latency by 37% and lowered per-request costs, which sped up confirmations for our customers."

Please confirm which option you want me to send to Janelle (I recommend Option A for the newsletter). Links: Google Doc (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AParcelGridDraft), HubSpot company (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/parcelgrid).

Marissa
Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attach: parcelgrid_case_draft_v2.docx
From: Janelle Park <janelle@parcelgrid.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Ramos <ben.ramos@redwood.com>, ParcelGrid Legal <legal@parcelgrid.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ParcelGrid customer narrative — draft for factual review and quote approval

Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks — v2 looks great. We prefer Option A for the newsletter (short and clean). Legal has signed the one-page release and attached the signed copy (signed_release_parcelgrid.pdf). Small nit: in the technical section please change "peak throughput" reference to the 1.2M requests/day figure (that’s the official number we track). Apart from that, you’re good to publish.

Approved quote (final): "Redwood helped ParcelGrid reduce latency and cut request costs, enabling faster customer confirmations."

Please let us know if you need anything else — we’re happy to be a reference.

Best,
Janelle
Head of Product
ParcelGrid

Attach: signed_release_parcelgrid.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: ParcelGrid — final approvals received, ready to publish

Team — good news: ParcelGrid signed the release and approved Option A. Final edits to make before publishing:

- Marissa: swap in Option A and update the technical stat to 1.2M requests/day. Then export web-ready copy and a short teaser for the newsletter.
- Monica: add the signed_release_parcelgrid.pdf to the reference folder and update the HubSpot record with the approved quote and publish date.
- Laura: schedule the case study to go live on Feb 25 and coordinate the customer newsletter pull.

I’ll confirm once Marketing publishes. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Vivek
Senior SDR, Customer References
Redwood Inference
